head_coach.name: Sergej Barbarez
head_coach.play_style_summary: Barbarez employs a highly physical, direct, and high-energy style of football emphasizing quick transitions. The system utilizes a compact defensive block with two banks of four, applying intense, coordinated high-pressing waves to force errors and transition rapidly to direct vertical attacks via the strikers.

key_players.name: Ermedin Demirović
key_players.performance_stats: Key starting forward who has shown clinical form for both VfB Stuttgart and the national team, leading Bosnia's front-line attack [2.2.4].

key_players.name: Tarik Muharemović
key_players.performance_stats: The most valuable defender in the squad, performing as a commanding central defender for US Sassuolo.

key_players.name: Amar Dedić
key_players.performance_stats: Dynamic, attacking full-back playing for SL Benfica, known for providing defensive solidity and essential width going forward.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the upcoming World Cup due to a meniscus knee injury requiring surgery and a lengthy recovery period [3.1.1].
Expected to miss the World Cup after sustaining an ankle fracture while playing for Borussia Mönchengladbach.
Doubtful or racing against time after suffering a shoulder injury during the qualification play-off final against Italy.
